evidence.quote: Can you escalate this or find a way to make the refund happen within 3 days?

observed_facts: The user insisted on a 3-day refund despite policy stating 5-7 business days for PayPal.
The agent correctly explained the 5-7 business days timeframe.
The user asked to escalate the request in step 18.
The agent transferred the user to a human agent in step 19.
inference: The task failed because the simulated user refused to accept the policy and pushed for an unsupported escalation, forcing the agent to transfer instead of completing the return.
needs_verification: Whether the user prompt should have accepted the return policy instead of demanding a policy violation.
parsed.summary: The task failed because the user insisted on an unsupported 3-day refund timeline and requested escalation, preventing the agent from completing the order return.
